page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated physical cores of an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 96.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance profile characterized by weak single-core capabilities but average multi-core efficiency. Single-core tests, such as stress-ng and Geekbench, place the instance in the bottom 25% of tested hardware, with single-threaded gzip compression falling into the bottom 10%. However, the 24 dedicated cores allow the instance to achieve average multi-core performance in stress-ng, Geekbench, and PassMark tests. Memory bandwidth remains average across both small-block cached reads at 983.75 GB/sec and large-block uncached reads at 90.83 GB/sec.

Given its resource distribution and performance characteristics, the ecs.sn2ne.6xlarge is qualitatively positioned as a cost-efficient option for parallelized, non-latency-sensitive workloads. It is well-suited for multi-threaded tasks such as static web serving, software compilation, and database operations, where it achieves average performance. However, it is less suitable for single-threaded applications or real-time LLM inference due to its weak single-core throughput.
